BaselineCheck.description: The last check of a runtime's standard tools ([`crate::baseline`]): only a hint, the declaration decides (Q5).

error.description: Why the check could not run (the runtime was not reachable).

missing.description: Standard commands not found on the runtime's PATH.

ComputerAccess.description: ComputerUse capability of an Agent on a runtime: `none` grants no Computer operation, `observe` grants inspect/observe, `control` adds act.

RuntimeBaseline.description: Declared environment baseline of an execution runtime: `standard` has the core Agent tools and BuckyOS access, `extended` adds build tool chains and heavy tools. Declared by whoever registers the runtime, never probed.

oneOf.description: The owner's desktop host (`host`): a node's embedded executor.

RuntimePlatform.description: The platform of a runtime: `os` is `linux | macos | windows`, `shell` the program name commands are written for (`bash`, `pwsh`, …).

baseline.description: The environment its registrar declares (Q5): decides the sessions' cmd_skills and what their prompts say.

baseline_check.description: The last check of its standard tools; a hint that never changes `baseline`.

builtin.description: Created by the host; cannot be unregistered.

capabilities.description: `{tools, network, os}` as far as known.

computer.description: ComputerUse the owner granted the agent on this runtime.

default.description: The session-runtime new sessions take unless one is named or inherited (the owner's `default_runtime_id`); exactly one record carries it.

exec.description: How the runtime layer reaches it (`agent_tool` RuntimeConfig); `None`: there is no executor for it yet.

platform.description: Learned from the runtime when it is checked.

roots.description: Where workspaces are best placed in it.

runtime_host.description: `native_host_id()` of the host that registered it.
